rows.label: FABRIC
rows.text: Large pieces from several pairs, laid on the bias by shade

rows.label: MAKE
rows.text: Flat seams where it pulls, raw overlaps on the body

rows.label: SHADE
rows.text: Dark at the shoulder, a shade lighter each step to the hem

notes: LOOK 01 is a long dropped-shoulder trench, and the whole collection in one garment: dark at the shoulders, a shade lighter at each step, pale at the hem. The pieces run on the diagonal, so the seams step down the coat like a line of slashes. Shoulder seams and armholes, which take strain, are flat seams with topstitching. The body panels overlap with raw edges.
